name: Automations
description: Automate repetitive work without writing code: appointment reminders, low-stock alerts and messages to customers that go out on their own.

agent.description: Automations (flows) for this hub — «when X happens, do Y». Two things live here. (1) The visual editor the owner uses: create, edit, enable and pause automations that react to an event, a schedule or a manual trigger; grant them what they may do; read their run history in plain language. (2) `flows.drafts.propose`, which is how YOU answer somebody who wants something to happen on its own — you write the automation as a DRAFT and it waits in Automations for them to check and turn on. Reach for it whenever a request is about something recurring, automatic, or «remind me / warn me / send it every time…». The module does not RUN automations; the hub's own kernel does.

ai.description:
Propose a DRAFT automation for this business — «when X happens, do Y». The draft does NOT run: it lands in Automations for the owner to check, fill in and turn on, and it holds no permissions until they grant them. Use it whenever the owner describes something they want to happen on its own.

WRITE `definition` EXACTLY IN THIS SHAPE — it is a frozen contract and anything else is refused:
{"schema_version":1,"triggers":[{"kind":"event","event":"customer.created"}],"steps":[{"id":"wait","kind":"delay","seconds":86400},{"id":"task","kind":"command","command":"tasks.tasks.create","params":{"title":"Llamar a {{input.name}}","priority":"high"}}]}

Rules: `triggers` and `steps` are ARRAYS (never `trigger`/`action`/`actions`). A step is `command` (runs one of the actions this hub has, with `params`), `condition` (a guard: `when`, and if it does not hold the run STOPS) or `delay` (`seconds`, counted FROM NOW). Steps run in order — there is no branch and no «else». Copy a field of what triggered it with `input.<field>` on its own, or inside text as `{{input.<field>}}`. Money is in cents. Put anything you had to guess in `notes`, in the owner's language.

Afterwards, say it is waiting for them in Automations and repeat what you were unsure about.
